sqlMap.select: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PR_NO FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'HWIN_APP' AND TARGET IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = #BUYER_ID#) AND KEY_9 = ' ' ORDER BY TARGET, KEY_1

SELECT A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, 'KRW' AS CUR, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.BUDGET_DEPT, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ADD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RD_DATE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CASE WHEN B.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.AGENT ELSE 'KRKORE0001' END ) AS AGENT_NAME, TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_QTY,'999,999,999,999,999.99')) AS TARGET_QTY, TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_PRICE,'999,999,999,999,999.99')) AS PRICE, TRIM(TO_CHAR((A.TARGET_QTY * A.TARGET_PRICE) ,'999,999,999,999,999.99')) AS AMT FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMCMPY B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PR_NO = #PR_NO#
AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE

SELECT COMPANY, DOCU_NO, DOCU_TITLE, DOCU_CONT, USER_ID, USER_NM, TO_CHAR(START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS APP_DATE, GET_CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO(COMPANY) AS APPR_ID FROM ICOGDOCU WHERE (COMPANY, DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT COM_CODE, TARGET FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PX' AND (COM_CODE, KEY_1) IN ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.REF_NO FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PR_NO = #PR_NO# ) )
sqlMap.insert:
INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APL_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, APP_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10 ) SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.ORDER_NO, A.USER_ID, B.USER_NAME_LOC, #APPR_ID# AS KEY_1, TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) AS KEY_2, '' AS KEY_3, '' AS KEY_4, '' AS KEY_5, '' AS KEY_6, '' AS KEY_7, '' AS KEY_8, '' AS KEY_9, '' AS KEY_10 FROM ICOGPASSLN A , ICOMLUSR B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO#
AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID

INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APM_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, SUBJECT, CONTENTS, APP_USER_ID, APP_USER_NAME, APP_DATE, KEY_1, KEP_2, KEP_3, KEP_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, CREATE_DATM, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #COMPANY#, #DOCU_NO#, #DOCU_TITLE#, #CONTENTS:CLOB#, #USER_ID#, #USER_NM#, #APP_DATE#, #APPR_ID#, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', SYSDATE, 'N' )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, A.SUBJECT, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(D.CODE,'501') AS COMP_CD, NVL(D.TEXT2,'') AS SHIFT_DATA FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOGDOCU C , ICOMCOD2 D WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO#
AND A.APP_USER_ID = B.USER_ID
AND A.BUYER = C.COMPANY AND A.DOC_NO = C.DOCU_NO
AND 'CMPC' = D.TYPE(+) AND A.BUYER = D.COMPANY_CODE(+)

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, DECODE(A.KEY_2, '2', '9', A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, B.USER_NAME_LOC, C.TEXT1 AS APPRDEPTNM, D.TEXT1 AS APPRGRDNM FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOMCOD2 C , ICOMCOD2 D WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO#
AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND C.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT
AND D.TYPE = 'C004' AND D.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND D.CODE = B.POSITION
